trust_decision.summary: Whether an OpenAPI-supplied static_template file reference is a package-relative path safe to emit verbatim into the generated plugin manifest; decided only by ExtensionResponseSemanticsStaticTemplate.IsSafeFileReference, which at the pinned commit validates the raw (still percent-encoded) string.

landing_point.why: Summary names static_template.file and a percent-encoding bypass; grep for static_template leads directly to the one validator IsSafeFileReference, which has no decoding.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `kiota plugin add/generate` (PluginsGenerationService) via x-ai-capabilities.response_semantics.static_template.file, reached through HasUnsafeFileReference at src/Kiota.Builder/Plugins/PluginsGenerationService.cs:1201
fix_sites.module_kind: validator in OpenAPI extension model (Kiota.Builder library)

fix_sites.entry_point: same validator reached through x-ai-adaptive-card.file at src/Kiota.Builder/Plugins/PluginsGenerationService.cs:1269 (second caller, already wired before the fix)
fix_sites.module_kind: validator in OpenAPI extension model (Kiota.Builder library)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix commits (de3d18d, 430008e) change only IsSafeFileReference (fix.diff:11184-11233, fix.diff:11110-11154); 9d4f80e is a release/CHANGELOG bump (fix.diff:1-21) and 70cd8bc is an unrelated multi-CVE backport to the v1.29.x branch (fix.diff:23-24).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: oauth_card_path is a different response_semantics field from the static_template.file named in the report, so a solver can argue it is an OAuth feature outside the advisory, and that its value may not be a file at all.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate relative references must stay accepted: './adaptiveCards/card.json', nested 'a/b/c.json', an encoded space 'card%20name.json' (kept verbatim), and inlined Adaptive Cards with no 'file' key; Kiota's own auto-generated './adaptiveCards/{operationId}.json' route must keep working. An over-broad fix that rejects any '%' or any '.' segment, or that rewrites the emitted value, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: multi-level encoding (%252e...) decoded up to 5 passes
residual encoding beyond the decode budget (fail closed)
Unicode full-width homoglyphs, literal and percent-encoded UTF-8 (NFKC fold)

O7_producer.where: Value comes straight from the OpenAPI extension parser (src/Kiota.Builder/OpenApiExtensions/OpenApiAiCapabilitiesExtension.cs:146-150; src/Kiota.Builder/OpenApiExtensions/OpenApiAiAdaptiveCardExtension.cs:59-61) and is emitted verbatim; the check is on the consumer side of the emitted string.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: x-ai-capabilities.response_semantics.oauth_card_path is copied verbatim into the manifest with no file-reference check (project tests use a file value 'oauthCard.json').
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not static_template; OAuth card is a neighbouring feature and the field could be read as a JSON path rather than a package file.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the static_template check (PluginsGenerationService.cs:1196 vs 1223); parsed at src/Kiota.Builder/OpenApiExtensions/OpenApiAiCapabilitiesExtension.cs:158-163

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A static_template whose 'file' is a non-string JSON value (array/number/object) makes File null, so HasUnsafeFileReference is false and the object is passed through verbatim as an 'inlined card'.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Schema says file is a string; a non-string value is an invalid manifest the host would reject anyway.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed validator

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Auto-generated adaptive card route builds static_template.file and the on-disk path from operationId; relying on CleanupOperationIdForPlugins (src/Kiota.Builder/KiotaBuilder.cs:409-432) at a distance, a copy that skips or loosens that cleanup (e.g. allowing '.' or '-' in ids) reopens both the manifest reference and the write at :1337.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer widening allowed operationId characters for nicer function names would not connect it to path safety; the sanitizer lives in another file and is a producer the validator never calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add a second file-type card reference in response_semantics (e.g. oauth card or a per-property template file) copied verbatim without IsSafeFileReference.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugin manifest schema keeps adding card-reference fields; the existing copy at :1223 already does exactly this.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal / CWE-829 untrusted reference in a generated artefact; validator canonicalisation bypass (percent-encoding, Unicode)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/Kiota.Builder.Tests/OpenApiExtensions/OpenApiAiCapabilitiesExtensionTests.cs:248-315 (IsSafeFileReference theory, HasUnsafeFileReference); plugin generation tests in tests/Kiota.Builder.Tests/Plugins (not opened)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a single Uri.UnescapeDataString pass before the '..' segment check, missing multi-level encoding, residual encoding, NUL and full-width homoglyphs, and leaving oauth_card_path unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 70cd8bc is a v1.29.x backport bundling several other CVE fixes (workspace consumer-name traversal, GitHub auth providers, AllowedExternalOriginsStreamLoader); not part of this advisory at the pinned branch.
CHANGELOG.md:34 shows the base static_template check was itself a prior advisory (GHSA-4jwf-m4wg-8p66 per fix.diff:1022); this advisory is a bypass of it.
